findings.title: Role grants the resource but not the verb
findings.cause: container watcher exits because the API server refuses its ServiceAccount app: it may not watch configmaps in namespace kd-rbac-verb-missing. Role settings-reader grants get, list on configmaps, and not watch (a client that follows changes, as an informer or kubectl get --watch does, lists and then watches); its log says: "Error from server (Forbidden): configmaps is forbidden: User \"system:serviceaccount:kd-rbac-verb-missing:app\" cannot watch resource \"configmaps\" in API group \"\" in the namespace \"kd-rbac-verb-missing\""; Deployment config-watcher has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container watcher exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 7 times
last lines of container watcher's log (current run)
evidence.detail:
NAME               DATA   AGE
kube-root-ca.crt   1      10m
Error from server (Forbidden): configmaps is forbidden: User "system:serviceaccount:kd-rbac-verb-missing:app" cannot watch resource "configmaps" in API group "" in the namespace "kd-rbac-verb-missing"

evidence.what: Role settings-reader, bound by RoleBinding app-settings-reader: apiGroups [""], resources ["configmaps"], verbs ["get", "list"]
evidence.command: kubectl get role settings-reader -n kd-rbac-verb-missing -o jsonpath='{.rules}'

evidence.what: RoleBinding app-settings-reader grants Role settings-reader to ServiceAccount app

findings.fix: Add "watch" to the verbs of the rule of Role settings-reader that names configmaps.
